Practised taking out common factors, factorising trinomials, and using perfect-square and difference-of-squares identities.
Arjun correctly found common factors in 2 attempts and used identities correctly in 2 attempts.
Used product-and-sum checks to correct sign choices in several trinomial examples.
Initially copied coefficients for x² + 5x + 6; later corrected this to (x + 2)(x + 3).
The coefficient-copying mix-up was not corrected after its last recorded occurrence.
end.parentNote: Arjun practised taking out common factors, finding number pairs from the product and sum, and using factorisation identities. They checked products and sums to correct sign choices, and correctly solved several examples including 2x(x² − 4) and difference of squares. At the start, they copied 5 and 6 as factors for x² + 5x + 6; this was corrected later in the lesson, although the same mix-up was not revisited after its last occurrence. At home, ask them to expand each proposed pair of brackets to check the middle term and constant.
